name: audio_alarm_clock_01
notes: Audio-only, added on the YAMNet-integration pass (see results/methodology_changes.md) alongside audio_alarm_siren_01.json -- see that manifest's notes for the general rationale (class-discrimination axis for the DSP-vs-YAMNet ablation). clock_alarm_with_baseline.wav = 15s of uniform noise (aura_mas/scripts/make_audio_baselines.py) + the real ESC-50 'clock_alarm' recording. Under YAMNet this fires as 'audio_alarm' (SURVEILLANCE_CLASSES maps YAMNet's 'Alarm' class -> audio_alarm). Empirically verified the real event scores Alarm=0.88 in the chunk starting at t=15s (see results/yamnet_integration_notes.md), hence t_start=15.0.
